fact: The massive gate is made from steel and mithril, laid with magical, magic-resistant alloys, and plated in adamantine.
source_quote: The party reached a massive gate made from steel and mithril, laid with magical, magic-resistant alloys, and plated in adamantine.
subject: massive gate

fact: Eight gnome guards wait behind the gate.
source_quote: Eight gnome guards waited behind it.
subject: gnome guards

fact: The head guard demands to know who the travelers are and why they have come.
source_quote: Their leader demanded to know who the travelers were and why they had come.
subject: head guard

fact: One guard expresses distrust toward Daz, stating that drow lie.
source_quote: One guard immediately distrusted Daz, saying, “You are a drow, and we know that drow lie.”
subject: gnome guard

fact: Gyrgum counters the guard's prejudice by claiming that orcs only tell the truth.
source_quote: Gyrgum countered, “But I am an orc, and everyone knows that orcs only tell the truth,”
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The guards are surprised to discover that Gyrgum is an orc cleric of Bahamut.
source_quote: bewildering the guards further when they realized he was an orc cleric of Bahamut.
subject: guards' realization

fact: Gyrgum confirms his true nature to the guards, saying, “Tis true. You see me truly.”
source_quote: Gyrgum answers their disbelief with, “Tis true. You see me truly.”
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Jimjar initially responds to the guard's question with his habitual catchphrase.
source_quote: Jimjar initially responds with his habitual “Wanna bet?”
subject: Jimjar

fact: Jimjar presents himself as merely another friend of the party.
source_quote: before presenting himself as merely another friend of the party.
subject: Jimjar

fact: Jimjar asserts that Daz is interested in exploration and growth rather than domination.
source_quote: Jimjar tries to reassure the guards about Daz: “Yes, yes, yes, his name harkens to the words Menzoberranzan, but he's really a really nice guy. He's all about exploring and growing, not about domination and world conquest.”
subject: Jimjar

fact: Jimjar claims Daz has been reading a popular book called The Up in the Overbright.
source_quote: Jimjar jokingly claims Daz has been reading a popular book called *The Up in the Overbright*
subject: The Up in the Overbright

fact: Daz explains that the group had been detained against their will by captors who wanted to exploit them.
source_quote: Daz explains that the party had been detained against their will, not for wrongdoing but so their captors could exploit them.
subject: Daz

fact: Daz states that the party gathered other travelers seeking good companions and a safer destination after escaping.
source_quote: After escaping, they gathered other travelers seeking good companions and a safer destination.
subject: Daz

fact: The party has arrived at Blingdenstone hoping for help and fellowship.
source_quote: Daz concludes that the group has found itself at Blingdenstone looking for the same kind of aid and fellowship.
subject: Blingdenstone

fact: Daz's name is stated by Jimjar to harken to the words Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: his name harkens to the words Menzoberranzan
subject: Menzoberranzan

fact: Gyrgum is identified as an orc cleric of Bahamut.
source_quote: he was an orc cleric of Bahamut
subject: Bahamut
